title: Pannexin-1 blockade in WWOX: the endpoint is normalized spontaneous burst frequency in Wwox-null neocortical slices, and the arm that produced the adverse point estimate had no vehicle time-control, so a drug effect and a time-dependent run-up are not separable
source: scientist-c, task MODULE-C8-20261024; handoff row Q-N-16 (disease-models/wwox/analysis/mechanism_intervention_map.md:787); record N-16 prose and manifest disease-models/wwox/research/deepdive_manifests/PMID34634460.json entry 3, receipt FTR-20260810-34634460-02; the one non-WWOX pannexin paper read for this row is PMID 33053775 (NOT WWOX EVIDENCE), same laboratory as the bound paper by shared authors and institution, endpoint incidence of convulsant-triggered events per slice, read 2026-10-23 (disease-models/wwox/research/module_batch_selection_scientist-c_20261023.md); PMID 29848662 (NOT WWOX EVIDENCE) is a different laboratory but non-WWOX tissue and a different endpoint, abstract only, parked
causal_statement: IPOTESI: the adverse point estimate behind the DEPRIORITIZE of pannexin-1 blockade (normalized spontaneous burst frequency approximately 2.55 during the blocker arm and approximately 2.6 at washout against an in-slice baseline of 1.0, no significance marker and no reported test, Wwox S-KO neocortical slice P13-P17) is not interpretable as an effect of the blocker, because the design carried no vehicle time-control arm; an upward drift of burst frequency over the recording would produce the same two numbers. A powered arm with a vehicle time-control, at an earlier developmental stage than P13-P17, discriminates drug effect from run-up and is the record's own stated revival trigger.
falsifier: a powered, significance-tested arm in Wwox-null neocortical slices in which normalized spontaneous burst frequency under a selective pannexin-1 blocker is lower than under vehicle at the matched recording time refutes the adverse reading and revives the node; a vehicle arm that drifts upward to the same degree as the published blocker arm refutes the reading of that arm as an effect of the compound in either direction; a blocker arm indistinguishable from a non-drifting vehicle arm establishes the no-effect statement the paper's prose already asserts, which its own numbers do not support
transfer_limit: the endpoint transfers only as a network measurement in an acute Wwox-null neocortical slice at the age measured; it carries nothing about any other WWOX system, nothing about human network activity, and nothing about any pannexin measurement outside WWOX, which is NOT WWOX EVIDENCE; no dose, administration or suitability statement is made or implied. Not medical advice.
